_comment: An HmIP-Wired distribution board: HmIPW-DRBL4 1.6.0, HmIPW-DRI32 1.2.2 and HmIPW-WRC6 1.0.8 with the
descriptions of pydevccu (MIT, a CCU's hmipserver answers), HmIPW-DRI16 1.4.6 from lab-2026-09.json, and five
links to the DRBL4 (run as shutters) whose LINK paramsets hold what the CCU's WebUI writes for the profile:

DRI32:2 -> DRBL4:3 SHUTTER_VIRTUAL_RECEIVER/MULTI_MODE_INPUT_TRANSMITTER_1 profile 3 (the WebUI of 3.87); DRI32:1 -> DRBL4:2 SHUTTER_VIRTUAL_RECEIVER/MULTI_MODE_INPUT_TRANSMITTER_1 profile 3; DRI16:1 -> DRBL4:6 SHUTTER_VIRTUAL_RECEIVER/MULTI_MODE_INPUT_TRANSMITTER_1 profile 1; WRC6:1 -> DRBL4:10 SHUTTER_VIRTUAL_RECEIVER/KEY_TRANSCEIVER profile 3; WRC6:2 -> DRBL4:14 SHUTTER_VIRTUAL_RECEIVER/KEY_TRANSCEIVER profile 4
